description: unlock my account after too many failed sign in attempts
utterances: locked myself out this morning typing the wrong thing too many times, can someone let me back in
I tried logging in three times with what I thought was the right password and now the system says my user is locked, can you undo that?

description: reset a password i no longer remember
utterances: cant remember my login password after the holidays, need a new one
I've been away for three weeks and have completely blanked on my password, is there a way to set a fresh one so I can start working again?

description: renew a password that has just expired
utterances: my password hit its expiry date today and now nothing lets me in
I got the warning about my password reaching the end of its ninety day period, ignored it, and this morning every system is rejecting me until I change it.

description: move two factor authentication to a new phone
utterances: got a new mobile and the authenticator app isnt on it yet
I replaced my handset over the weekend and the six digit codes are still tied to the old device, how do I get the prompts onto the new one?

description: authenticator codes keep getting rejected
utterances: the app gives me a code but the login page says its invalid every time
Every code my authenticator generates is refused as wrong or expired even though I type it in within seconds, so I'm stuck at the second step of signing in.

description: set up accounts for someone joining my team
utterances: we have a new hire starting monday who needs logins created
A new analyst joins my department next week and I'd like their user profile, group memberships and system access ready before their first day.

description: disable accounts of someone who has left
utterances: one of my reports left friday, please shut off their access
A contractor on my team finished their engagement yesterday and I need all of their logins switched off and their access to our systems revoked.

description: vpn client refuses to connect
utterances: the vpn just spins and then errors out, cant get on at all
Since this morning the remote access client sits on connecting for a minute and then throws an authentication failed message, and I've already rebooted twice.

description: vpn connection drops every few minutes
utterances: vpn connects fine but kicks me off constantly
I can get onto the corporate network from home without trouble, but roughly every ten minutes the tunnel dies and I have to reconnect.

description: get vpn access for the first time
utterances: starting to work from home next week, how do i get remote access set up
My manager approved a hybrid schedule and I've never had the remote connection client, so I need it provisioned along with whatever permissions are required.

description: connect my device to the office wireless network
utterances: cant get my laptop onto the wifi in the building today
The staff wireless shows up in the list but when I pick it my laptop asks for credentials it then refuses, while the guest one works fine.

description: get permission to a shared folder or drive
utterances: need to be added to the finance team folder on the network
I've moved into a new project and the documents I need live in a departmental share that currently tells me access is denied when I open it.

description: cannot sign in to my work mailbox
utterances: outlook keeps asking for my password and wont accept it
Since the weekend my mail client throws a credentials prompt on every launch and rejects what I enter, though the same password works for everything else.

description: mailbox has reached its storage limit
utterances: getting a warning that my inbox is out of space
My mail account is showing a quota exceeded banner and incoming messages are bouncing, so I either need more space or help archiving old items.

description: install an approved application on my computer
utterances: can you put the diagramming tool on my machine please
I need the statistics package from the approved catalogue set up on my work laptop before the project kicks off next Monday.

description: get a license for a paid application
utterances: the design suite says my trial ended, need a proper seat
The video editing program has been running in trial mode and now it's locked, so I'd like a paid seat assigned to me under the company agreement.

description: an application crashes every time it opens
utterances: the crm app dies the second i click on it
Ever since yesterday's patch the reporting tool shows its splash screen for a moment and then closes itself with no error, on every attempt.

description: get temporary administrator rights on my machine
utterances: need local admin for an hour to install a driver
I'm testing a hardware development kit that requires elevated privileges to load its drivers, could I be granted that on my workstation for the afternoon?

description: operating system update keeps failing
utterances: windows update gets to 40 percent and rolls back every night
My laptop has been trying to apply the same system update for a week, it restarts, sits on a spinner, then reverts and asks me to try again.

description: computer has become painfully slow
utterances: my pc takes ten minutes to boot and everything lags
Over the past month my desktop has become sluggish to the point that opening a spreadsheet freezes it, the fan runs constantly and it's getting hard to work.

description: recover a file that was deleted or overwritten
utterances: accidentally saved over the wrong document, can i get yesterdays version back
A folder of project drawings vanished from the shared drive this week and nobody on the team admits to removing it, is there a backup we can pull from?

description: microphone or camera not working in video meetings
utterances: people in calls cant hear me and my webcam shows black
In every conference call this week my headset is detected but nobody hears a word I say, and switching to the built in mic makes no difference.

description: get a company laptop issued to me
utterances: i still dont have a work machine, when can i pick one up
I joined two weeks ago and have been borrowing a colleague's spare computer, so I'd like my own standard issue device assigned as soon as possible.

description: replace an old laptop that can no longer keep up
utterances: this laptop is five years old and cant run our tools anymore, time for a swap
My current machine is past its refresh date, the battery lasts twenty minutes and it can't handle the modelling software my role requires, so I'd like a newer model.

description: repair a laptop with a cracked screen or broken keyboard
utterances: dropped my laptop and the display is shattered
Coffee went over my keyboard and now half the keys don't respond and the trackpad is sticky, can it be fixed or do I get a spare meanwhile?

description: report a company laptop as lost or stolen
utterances: my work laptop was taken from my car last night
I left my bag in a cafe with my company computer inside and it hasn't turned up at lost property, so I want the device wiped and flagged.

description: laptop will not turn on at all
utterances: pressed the power button and nothing happens, no lights no fan
My machine was fine last night, this morning it's completely dead, no charging indicator even when plugged into a known good outlet, and holding the button does nothing.

description: get an extra monitor keyboard or headset
utterances: can i get a second screen for my desk
I'm on spreadsheets all day and working off the laptop panel alone is hurting my neck, so I'd like an external display, a docking station and a proper mouse.

description: hand back company equipment i no longer need
utterances: got a spare monitor and old dock here, where do i drop them off
My contract ends at the end of the month and I have a laptop, charger and headset that belong to the company, what's the process for giving them back?

description: add an office printer to my computer
utterances: how do i get the printer on the third floor showing up on my laptop
I've moved desks to a different wing and the copier nearest me isn't in my list of devices, so I can't send anything to it.

description: print jobs are stuck and never come out
utterances: sent three documents to print and they just sit there forever
Everything I send to the shared printer shows as pending in the queue for ages and then quietly disappears, though my colleague next to me prints without issue.

description: printer is jammed or out of toner
utterances: the copier by reception is flashing a paper jam light again
The big multifunction device on our floor is printing faint grey pages and shows a low cartridge warning, can someone come and swap the consumable?
